title: Quick Accent conficts with Keyboard Manager remaps
author: RobertoRRW

judgment.rationale: The issue has a deterministic cross-module reproduction: Quick Accent sends a virtual Backspace that is intercepted by a Keyboard Manager Backspace remap, producing the remapped character instead of deleting the source letter. A user confirmed the issue on 0.100.2.
evidence: Swapping Backspace with another key causes Quick Accent replacement to emit that other key.
A contributor identified Quick Accent's synthetic virtual Backspace as the relevant operation.
A warning for simultaneous Quick Accent and Backspace remapping is proposed as a mitigation.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a cross-module design to define whether synthetic Quick Accent cleanup should bypass Keyboard Manager remaps or expose a supported conflict warning.

fix_assessment.rationale: The root interaction is public and reproducible, but the correct coupling boundary and safe bypass mechanism require design review.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent's synthetic Backspace is remapped by Keyboard Manager, turning accent replacement into incorrect text such as `a/á`.
known_information: The bug specifically requires a Backspace remap.
Quick Accent intentionally sends Backspace to remove the original letter.
inferences: A bypass flag or module-aware synthetic input may solve the conflict, but could create coupling.
A warning is a lower-risk mitigation but not a behavioral fix.
issue_context.analysis: No additional author evidence is needed; ownership and synthetic-input policy are the missing decisions.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: Whether PowerToys permits module-originated synthetic input to bypass Keyboard Manager.
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether the behavior can be fixed without fragile coupling.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Confirm the cross-module input policy before implementation.

actions.label: Queue Quick Accent/Keyboard Manager conflict design
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: This is reproducible on 0.100.2 when Backspace is remapped: Quick Accent's synthetic Backspace is processed by Keyboard Manager and becomes the remapped key. The next step is a cross-module design decision—either provide a safe way for Quick Accent cleanup input to bypass remaps, or add an explicit conflict warning as a mitigation if that coupling is not supportable.
